BiblicalUsage: ṭûwach is the word the Bible uses when it means to plaster, to smear with lime. In Leviticus 14:42, shall plaister the house, and it appears again in 1 Chronicles 29:4.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put ṭûwach exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
